title: The Slow Leak of Cash Under the Mattress
description:
Discover how a steady 3% inflation rate strips away almost half of your buying power over 20 years. Learn why holding physical cash or keeping it in basic bank accounts is a guaranteed way to lose wealth, and why moving into assets is the only way to outrun the system.

Free 7-day Money Reset checklist + calculators: https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/money-reset/

Educational content, not financial advice. Narration and visuals are AI-assisted.
